subject: Question on control settings in lavaan

messages.author: 12fdd832cacb825e
messages.subject: Question on control settings in lavaan
parts:
With the default optimizer (NLMINB), what is the control option to increase allowed iterations? I'm having trouble finding an explicit source for lavaan, and have found reference to both "maxit" and "Iter.max".

It really doesn't matter a whole lot, since control seems to ignore the "wrong" one and I can just list both, but it's been niggling at me.

I'm running lavaan (specifically sem() ) via runMI, if that matters.

Thanks,

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Question on control settings in lavaan
parts:
from the help pages, it looks like iter.max= is an argument for nlminb() and maxit= is an argument for optim().  So the former should be the correct one (by default), but I forget the conditions under which lavaan may/not switch to a different optimizer.  See the ?lavOptions help page for a description of the optim.method
